about: Kandinsky-6 Pro distilled (kandinskylab/Kandinsky-6.0-Pro-distill-5s-Diffusers @ 1018d5828716e8bea3de99609f45c924de9c5564, code kandinskylab/kandinsky-6 @ eac06e39b904940baff2c408e925cdb0c4529269): text to 5 s video with joint audio (121 frames at 24 fps, mono 44.1 kHz), native Zig engine `kandinsky6`, on demand. The weights are the unmodified Hugging Face snapshot directory of that revision. options.fp32_linear, clip_linear and qwen_rope_freq (tf32_rna, tf32_truncate or fp32) and qwen_inv_freq (a file of 64 little-endian f32, Qwen2.5-VL's rotary inv_freq captured on the target) and audio (the audio decoder's and vocoder's numeric choices, one JSON object with every field named; its shape is documented in src/engines/kandinsky6_tool.zig) have no default: the engine refuses to load without them, or with any of them partial, and their values come from the GPU qualification (audio: the audio gates), so install.sh takes them from TOOL_OPTIONS. vae_free_mb defaults to 8192 in the engine. Fields in `provisional` are not final; a smoke run with this profile reports `provisional`, never `pass`.
provisional: tool.options (fp32_linear, clip_linear, qwen_rope_freq, the qwen_inv_freq file and the audio object from GPU qualification; resident_mb, an estimate until measured)

tool.name: Kandinsky-6 Pro distilled (5 s video with audio)
